# Halloway Ridge Review Meeting — Verbatim Extracts

**Recorded:** 2031-03-11
**Authority:** primary (transcript of record)

The following passages are transcribed verbatim. Punctuation is as spoken and
as certified by the minute-taker. Any reproduction must match byte for byte.

## Extract A — on calibration

“The probe is only as honest as its last calibration,” Ravensworth said, “and ours was ninety days ago.”

## Extract B — on causation

Sulfate crust — not firmware — is the proximate cause of the drift we recorded.

## Extract C — on elevation

No unit shall be deployed above 2,400 m without a written variance from the Board.

## Extract D — on the uplift figure

In preliminary testing, the uplift was 11.4%; we do not yet call that a result.

## Note

Extracts A through D are the only certified verbatim passages from this
meeting. Paraphrases circulating in other documents are not certified and must
not be presented as quotations.
